title: Kim and the Table by the Window
synopsis: The friends show their six sound pages at the Market Street library; Kim chooses a small way to contribute, and Ben receives a thank-you bookmark.
continuity_state: Before: The blue book has stayed safely overnight on a staff library shelf after Saturday drop-off. The Sunday story table is the next afternoon. Ben owns the book, whose six pages are complete. After: Sunday afternoon library sharing completes successfully. All six friends are present with adults. Kim points to Reed Meadow without being obliged to speak more. The librarian gives Ben a loose paper bookmark showing the library window and the words THANK YOU, WILLOW BEND. Ben tucks it inside the front cover: the book remains six pages. The book returns in its cloth bag with Ben on the bus, and all children are home that evening.
